message: Additional exact #3118 blocker evidence, read-only review while primary AX5 remains owned elsewhere in this lane: scripts/ci/dashboard_sustained_performance_xcuitest.swift@db7773c5 explicitly requests XCTHitchMetric(application: app), XCTCPUMetric(application: app), and XCTMemoryMetric(application: app) in one measure block.
